mapper.select: select rule_id, rule_name, dispute_type, max_amount, priority, status, is_delete, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from ry_rental.ry_rental_compensation_rule where is_delete = 0 order by priority asc, create_time desc, rule_id desc

select rule_id, rule_name, dispute_type, max_amount, priority, status, is_delete, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from ry_rental.ry_rental_compensation_rule where rule_id = #{ruleId} and is_delete = 0

select rule_id, rule_name, dispute_type, max_amount, priority, status, is_delete, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from ry_rental.ry_rental_compensation_rule where is_delete = 0 and status = 0 and (dispute_type = #{disputeType} or dispute_type = 0) order by case when dispute_type = #{disputeType} then 0 else 1 end, priority asc, rule_id desc limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into ry_rental.ry_rental_compensation_rule (rule_name, dispute_type, max_amount, priority, status, create_by, create_time, remark, is_delete) values (#{ruleName}, #{disputeType}, #{maxAmount}, #{priority}, #{status}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark}, 0)
mapper.update: update ry_rental.ry_rental_compensation_rule set rule_name = #{ruleName}, dispute_type = #{disputeType}, max_amount = #{maxAmount}, priority = #{priority}, status = #{status}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate(), remark = #{remark} where rule_id = #{ruleId} and is_delete = 0

update ry_rental.ry_rental_compensation_rule set is_delete = 1, remove_by = #{operator}, remove_time = sysdate(), update_by = #{operator}, update_time = sysdate() where rule_id = #{ruleId} and is_delete = 0
